title: His Majesty the Demon King's Housekeeper Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: The September issue of Akita Shoten 's Monthly Princess magazine announced on Thursday that writer Saiko Wadori and artist Mika Kajiyama 's His Majesty the Demon King's Housekeeper ( Maō Heika no Osōji-gakari ) manga will end in its next chapter in the magazine's November issue in October.
author: ANN

title: MAPPA Reveals The Biggest Change in Its Critically Acclaimed Dark Fantasy Sequel
content: MAPPA is one of the most renowned animation studios in the industry, known for adapting some of the biggest anime series of all time, including Jujutsu Kaisen and Attack on Titan Final Season.
author: ComicBook

title: SAG-AFTRA Lists Voice Actor Michael Donovan's Death
content: Donovan had numerous roles in anime, including Ryoga Hibiki in the original Ranma ½ anime, Cye Mouri in Ronin Warriors , Zouken Matou in Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel , Master Roshi in an older dub of Dragon Ball , and Primus in Transformers: Cybertron .
author: ANN

title: 3 Reasons Why Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2 Is the Anime’s Best Season
content: MAPPA’s Jujutsu Kaisen anime has been a sensation ever since it premiered in October 2020. The series introduced a darker edge that most shonen anime lack, proving that this element is what truly modernizes it.
author: ComicBook

title: Mechanical Designer Katsushi Murakami DIes at 83
content: Murakami was born on September 23, 1942 in Gifu, Japan. Murakami served as a mechanical designer for numerous anime including Shin Tetsujin 28 , Gold Lightan - The Golden Warrior , Machine Robo: Battle Hackers , Video Warrior Laserion , Reideen the Brave , Gekisō!
author: ANN

title: Teki Yatsuda's Myther Manga to End
content: Manga author Teki Yatsuda announced on their X (formerly Twitter ) account that they have submitted the final chapter of their Myther manga on Tuesday. Yatsuda did not state when the final chapter will be published.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia’s Timeskip Confirms All Might’s Replacement Isn’t Deku, But He’s Perfect
content: My Hero Academia has come to an end, as even its latest special, I Am a Hero Too, has arrived, providing the perfect conclusion to the series. This shonen anime had one of the best endings, perfectly wrapping up the long run of arguably one of the last shonen series with a large-scale narrative.
author: ComicBook

title: Anime NYC Holds Panels for Big West/Macross, English Dub Premieres of Go Forward. Anime, 27th Detective Conan Film
content: The Anime NYC convention announced over the past week that it will host a panel for Big West and the Macross franchise , as well as a premiere screening for SkySet Entertainment 's English dub for the Go Forward ( Massugu ni Ikō ) television anime.
author: ANN

title: RWBY Plans Major Comeback With New Television And Movie Projects
content: When it comes to anime, there has long been debates when it comes to what falls under the umbrella of the medium. For as long as we can remember, series like Avatar: The Last Airbender have long been debated as to whether or not it meets the criteria for what is considered an anime.
